scope: future validation-only; do not run in R4-3A
acoustic_evidence: frozen R3-1D 40-phone logits on 0.50 s crops

alignment.state: DP(i,t): expected-phone index i and acoustic probe index t
alignment.emission: negative log-softmax evidence for expected phone over a contiguous probe span
alignment.substitution: consume a contiguous span whose sustained best competing real phone differs from expected
alignment.deletion: advance expected index without assigning an acoustic span; global skip cost only
alignment.advance_time: consume another probe in the current contiguous emission span
alignment.optional_insertion: disabled in first R4-3B because addition words are excluded
alignment.cost_policy: No costs selected in R4-3A. For R4-3B, use frozen log-softmax emissions and global Laplace-smoothed MATCH/SUBSTITUTION/DELETION priors estimated once from TRAIN only; no phone-, speaker-, duration-, or validation-tuned costs.
alignment.decision: DELETE only when the best monotonic path skips Ei; SUBSTITUTION only when Ei consumes a span dominated by a sustained competing phone. Low P(Ei) alone is insufficient.

selection: single pre-registered deterministic run; transition priors from TRAIN only; no validation cost tuning
anti_duration_controls: fixed 0.50 s crop and fixed 40 ms stride
word-duration and expected-length matched validation diagnostic
compare against frozen duration-only and R4-1 baselines

hard_gates.speaker_rule: for speakers with >=30 deletions, deletion recall >=0.25
